whyItMatters: unserialize deserializes javascript objects from bytes, so hostile input can trigger gadget execution during decoding.
actions: Replace unserialize with JSON.parse with schema validation for any bytes that cross a trust boundary.
If object graphs must persist, authenticate the bytes (MAC/signature) and verify before decoding.
Re-run the scan and confirm no unserialize call remains reachable from untrusted bytes.
verification: Rescan shows no unserialize reachable from untrusted bytes, and hostile payloads decode to inert data or fail closed.
